sources.excerpt: The PDF currently embedded by Clarity's Dinner Menu page contains 25 distinct named food products across First Course and Main Course, with descriptions but no comprehensive allergen matrix.

The Owner-powered live ordering surface identifies 442 Maple Ave E and exposes 23 distinct current food products after Popular repeats are consolidated. Six are additional to the current dinner PDF: French Onion Soup Kit, Wild Mushroom Bisque, Pear & Apple Salad, Tuna, Ribeye, and Burger.

The PDF currently embedded as Tonight's Tasting Menu names four food products: Seared Giant Tiger Prawns, Lobster & Black Truffle Risotto, Mountain River Venison Backstrap, and Chocolate Hazelnut Cake. Unnamed chef and pastry gifts are not enumerable products.
The current dessert PDF contains eight desserts, two coffee preparations, and seven teas. Its rum, cognac, armagnac, port, and Sauternes sections are alcohol-only and excluded.

The current cocktails/beer PDF contains one explicitly named nonalcoholic product, Clausthaler Non Alcoholic IPA. All other listed wines, cocktails, beers, and cider are alcoholic and excluded. The printed '>0.5%' notation conflicts with its Non Alcoholic label and is preserved as a source typo, not silently corrected.

Fresh targeted searches for the exact Vienna identity, current menus, allergens, ingredients, nutrition, official documents, and linked ordering reconfirmed the official surfaces and found no restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix or conflicting Vienna identity.
The current official Clarity site identifies the restaurant at 442 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180, publishes daily hours, and links dining, reservations, ordering, catering, and the current menu hub.

Fresh browser inspection of the current menu hub found exactly five live document links: Dinner, Tasting, Dessert, Wine, and Craft Cocktails/Beer/BTG. The previously indexed Father's Day link is no longer present.
The official reservation page invites current bookings for lunch, dinner, the Chef's Table, Main Dining Room, and covered patio and links the restaurant's OpenTable profile.

Clarity's catering FAQ says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate gluten-free, vegan, allergy, and other dietary restrictions and asks guests to call directly for specific requests.
